comment: The manufactured solution and the plate data are defined in writeManufacturedSolution.py in the case directory, which the driver imports

distHex.description: blockMesh mesh with the interior points moved randomly by up to 15% of the local spacing

tri.description: unstructured triangular mesh from Gmsh with the same target spacing

clamped_moment_relaxation.comment: clampedMoment relaxationFactor per level for the segregated solver; its loop gain grows with refinement

acceptance.comment: applied to the variants with check_orders; the other variants must only complete with finite errors
